tier_resolution_logic.old_bug: ai.tsx was using profiles.role (stale) to determine AI limits
tier_resolution_logic.fix_applied: ai.tsx now uses subscriptionStatus.subscription from SubscriptionContext
subscription_context_logic: 1. Check profile role for admin/super_admin -> grant VIP immediately
2. Query subscriptions table with plans(tier) join
3. Filter for active subscriptions (status='active' AND (current_period_end IS NULL OR > now))
4. Return highest tier among active subscriptions
5. Default to 'free' if no active subscription

expected_behavior.Premium_user: AI screen shows 'X of 10 analyses remaining', subscription page shows 'X/10'
expected_behavior.Free_user: AI screen shows 'X of 3 analyses remaining', subscription page shows 'X/3'
